newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh Q1 inflation 4.6 pct, lower than forecast.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh Q1 inflation 4.6 pct, lower than forecast.

text.p: Kazakh Prime Minister Akezhan Kazhegeldin said on Tuesday inflation for the first three months of this stood at 4.6 percent, 0.9 percentage points lower than forecast.
"Inflation for the first quarter is lower by 0.9 percent. We forecast inflation at 5.5 percent but it came to 4.6 percent," Kazhegeldin told diplomats and journalists.
Official statistics said inflation for the same period last year was 8.5 percent. Annual inflation for 1997 is officially targeted to slow to 15-17 percent from 28.7 percent last year.
